title: Required Marker Span
brief: A genomics pipeline scans a long read, written as a string of letters, for the tightest region that contains a set of required marker letters. Some markers must be present more than once for the region to be useful.

Implement shortestCoveringSpan(s, t), where s is the read and t lists the required markers, and return the shortest contiguous piece of s that contains every letter of t at least as many times as it appears in t.
